purpose: Teach: 尺度/原題/考案/多種/年版/義務づけ/失格/事業主

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究の評価尺度を明示しろ
lines.en: Ren, make your research evaluation criteria explicit.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Measured pace. The weight of expectation behind simple words. A pause after the name—this is a person being called to account, not addressed casually.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の原題を見直しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm reviewing the original title of the paper right now.
lines.style: Careful, slightly defensive. Speaking to be understood precisely. Soft attack, steady through the middle. The tone of someone aware he's being evaluated.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、新手法を考案するには時間がかかるぞ
lines.en: Ren, developing a new methodology takes time. Don't rush it.
lines.style: Steady, almost philosophical. Not impatient—clarifying. A slight emphasis on 「takes time」, as if reminding him not to panic. The voice of someone who has seen this stage before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。多種の文献を読破しました
lines.en: Yes. I've read through a wide range of literature.
lines.style: Quiet pride under the surface. Reporting completed work. Even pace, no rushing to impress. A small breath before answering—he knows this matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、最新年版の論文集も参照しろ
lines.en: Ren, consult the latest annual collection of papers as well.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Each point lands. Slight staccato quality—this is instruction, not suggestion. The boss knowing exactly what gaps exist.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授からゼミ参加を義務づけられました
lines.en: Yes. The professor has made seminar participation mandatory.
lines.style: Accepting without complaint. Neutral delivery. He's saying 「I understand the requirement》 without elaborating. A note of resignation that doesn't become bitterness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データ改ざんは失格事項だ
lines.en: Ren, data falsification is grounds for disqualification.
lines.style: Quiet but absolute. This is not negotiable. Low intensity but unshakeable certainty. The kind of statement that hangs in the air after it's spoken.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究の事業主とお打合せです
lines.en: Yes. I have a meeting scheduled with the co-research partner.
lines.style: Formal closing tone. The word 「meeting》 lands with finality. Slight lift at the end—signaling the end of this part of the conversation. Professional, complete.
